from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any
from info import DATABASE_URI, DATABASE_NAME

class MediaRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for media database operations."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def save_file(self, media):
        """Save a file record."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_search_results(self, query, file_type=None, max_results=10, offset=0, filter=True):
        """Get search results for a query."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_file_details(self, query):
        """Get file details by file_id."""
        pass

class UsersChatsRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for user and chat database operations."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def add_user(self, id, name):
        """Add a new user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def is_user_exist(self, id):
        """Check if a user exists."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def total_users_count(self):
        """Get total user count."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def ban_user(self, user_id, ban_reason="No Reason"):
        """Ban a user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def remove_ban(self, id):
        """Unban a user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_ban_status(self, id):
        """Get ban status of a user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_users(self):
        """Get all users."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_user(self, user_id):
        """Delete a user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self):
        """Get banned users and chats."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def add_chat(self, chat, title):
        """Add a new chat."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_chat(self, chat):
        """Get chat details."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def re_enable_chat(self, id):
        """Re-enable a disabled chat."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def update_settings(self, id, settings):
        """Update chat settings."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_settings(self, id):
        """Get chat settings."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def disable_chat(self, chat, reason="No Reason"):
        """Disable a chat."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def total_chat_count(self):
        """Get total chat count."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_chats(self):
        """Get all chats."""
        pass

class ConnectionsRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for connection database operations."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def add_connection(self, group_id, user_id):
        """Add a new connection."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def active_connection(self, user_id):
        """Get active connection for a user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def all_connections(self, user_id):
        """Get all connections for a user."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def if_active(self, user_id, group_id):
        """Check if a connection is active."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def make_active(self, user_id, group_id):
        """Make a connection active."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def make_inactive(self, user_id):
        """Make a connection inactive."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_connection(self, user_id, group_id):
        """Delete a connection."""
        pass

class FiltersRepository(ABC):
    """Interface for filters database operations."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def add_filter(self, grp_id, text, reply_text, btn, file, alert):
        """Add a new filter."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def find_filter(self, group_id, name):
        """Find a filter by name."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def get_filters(self, group_id):
        """Get all filters for a group."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_filter(self, message, text, group_id):
        """Delete a specific filter."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def del_all(self, message, group_id, title):
        """Delete all filters for a group."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def count_filters(self, group_id):
        """Count filters for a group."""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def filter_stats(self):
        """Get global filter statistics."""
        pass
